description: Search BuyUKeSIM travel/data eSIM plans for a country. Returns plan name, data amount, validity days, USD price, package code and a buy link that opens checkout on that exact plan. Structured output adds, per plan: covered countries, local carriers, 5G, top-up support, hotspot (allowed on every plan) and the country traffic exits in. A feature the supplier does not state is null (unknown), never false. Pass a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. GB, US, TR, JP). Omit country to get popular/featured plans. Data only: no phone number, no SMS (for that see get_uk_number_info).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. GB, US, TR, JP. Optional.

name: search_esim_plans
